title: Shared definitions — Stoin Control ↔ Utopia Homes Management Contract v1.0
$comment: Encodes RC2 §8 common response rules and the primitive formats used by §§9-13. These definitions deliberately encode the contract text and nothing stricter; a constraint not stated in the contract is not asserted here.

observedAt.$comment: RC2 §8: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, whole-second precision, trailing Z. Fractional seconds are NOT permitted for observed_at.

rfc3339Utc.$comment: RC2 §11.2 deployed_at: 'Provider deployment RFC 3339 UTC timestamp'. UTC (trailing Z) is required. The contract does not restate §8's whole-second rule for this member, so optional fractional seconds are accepted here. See README 'Interpretations taken', item I-1.

uuid.$comment: RC2 §7/§13: UUID v4. Version nibble 4 and variant nibble 8/9/a/b are enforced. Uppercase hexadecimal is accepted because the contract does not require lowercase and §13 requires an exact echo of the caller's value. See README 'Interpretations taken', item I-2.

capabilityContractVersion.$comment: RC2 §12.2: capability contract semantic version MAJOR.MINOR. This is the capability's own version and is NOT constrained to the management contract's 1.0.

managementContractVersion.$comment: RC2 §14: management contract major.minor token, as listed in supported_management_contracts.

artifactDigest.$comment: RC2 §11.2: lowercase 'sha256:' prefix plus exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.

healthStatus.$comment: RC2 §10.2. 'unknown' is a RECOGNIZED v1.0 value meaning insufficient evidence; per §14 it MUST NOT be treated as an unrecognized enum token.

reasonCode.$comment: RC3 §10. The generic code is 'unspecified'; 'unknown' is NOT a valid reason code in v1.0 — it was renamed to remove the collision with the health status of the same name. 'no_enabled_capabilities' was added in RC3 for the zero-enabled configuration state.
